create_class_SpecialVocab: create a SpecialVocab instance to load tokenizer merges, special token IDs, and chat templates from a tokenizer directory
build_class_BpeVocab: build a BpeVocab instance from GPT-2 BPE tokenizer files (vocab.json or tokenizer.json) for GGUF conversion
build_class_SentencePieceVocab: build a SentencePieceVocab instance from a tokenizer.model file using sentencepiece for GGUF vocab export
build_class_MistralVocab: build a MistralVocab instance from mistral-common tokenizer files supporting SentencePiece and Tekkenizer backends
create_class_SpecialVocab_add_to_gguf: call SpecialVocab.add_to_gguf to write merges, special token IDs, add_special_token flags, and chat template to a GGUFWriter
